name: LNC Technology Co., Ltd
summary: LNC Technology Co., Ltd focuses on the design, production, and distribution of advanced control systems, specifically precision controllers and intelligent manufacturing solutions within Taiwan. The company's extensive product portfolio includes sophisticated control units for a variety of applications, such as slider and joint robots, as well as different types of industrial machinery like woodworking equipment, lathes, milling machines, and grinders. They also provide specialized controllers for plastic molding and laser processing. Beyond hardware, LNC Technology develops cutting-edge vision and artificial intelligence (AI) systems, comprehensive Industry 4.0 solutions, and integrated smart production lines, exemplified by their WIL series, along with various associated peripherals. The firm is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.
